thread:
tess.sawyer: Quick ask — EU pilot 'Praxis Labs' (dedicated) burned through committed capacity during onboarding. Sales is asking for a one-off overage credit + net60 on the first invoice while they stabilize. Need finance/revops sign-off ASAP. Proposed: one-time credit of €12,000 to cover excess tokens + set invoice #11234 to net60.

omar_finops: Can you drop the usage delta and expected normalization timeline? Also do we have the signed SOW/amendment?

tess.sawyer: Yep — usage + plan below. Will get signature but sales wants conditional approval before drafting amendment.

```
Committed: 8 dedicated seats (monthly)
Observed (first 10 days): 13 seats equivalent (spike from onboarding prompts)
Estimated bill delta: €12,000 (one-off)
Normalization expectation: ~3–4 weeks with prompt engineering and rate limits
Contract: SOW signed, consumption appendix unsigned (amendment needed)
```

lucy_revops: Need ARR/GR impact and revenue recognition note. If we're doing a refundable credit vs. a discount that affects revenue recognition differently. Also suggest we tag this as `pilot-ops-credit` for reporting.

ian_contracts: We can't apply the credit or change payment terms until we have a signed amendment or an email acknowledgment from the customer. I can draft a short amendment: add clause for one-off credit & extended payment term for invoice #11234.

meera_finance: From finance side: one-off credits up to €15k can be approved by the finance lead; net60 for a first pilot invoice is acceptable. Need GL code and tax treatment confirmation. Also confirm whether this is a contra-revenue credit or a prepaid adjustment.

tess.sawyer: GL code request — prefer 4302 contra-rev. Tax: customer is EU VAT-registered, we'll treat as adjustment to invoice (credit memo). Sales will secure signed amendment today.

cfo_bot: Approved by finance lead: one-off credit €12,000 and net60 for invoice #11234 contingent on signed amendment or signed email thread. Please route to billing and include `pilot-ops-credit` tag. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-2026-045 for €12,000, applied to invoice #11234. Payment terms updated to net60. GL mapping: 4302. Tax note: credit issued as invoice adjustment, VAT handled per EU rules.

lucy_revops: Thanks — I'll label the deal and add to the postmortem for the pilot playbook so we can update quota/limits to avoid repeat. :memo:

tess.sawyer: Thanks all — I'll attach the signed amendment to the CRM and confirm once legal signs. Closing loop in a few hours. :v:
